description: Ardelia alone (P0, Dreams of the Starry Beach, Hot Work) vs Rhodagn, ultimate charged. Her basic chain's Final Strike on the clean enemy opens her combo window; the combo's bomb forces Corrosion (7 s) and Hot Work gives her Nature DMG for it; her battle skill then consumes the Corrosion: that ram already has her Physical and Arts Susceptibility (+20%, 30 s) and the weapon's Arts DMG Taken (+28%, 25 s), and no Corrosion shred. Wooly Party below P3: one hit every 0.3 s on the one enemy, 11 hits. A second chain and battle skill follow on the plain enemy.
